🌞 Who needs Sora? 

Michael SpencerJun 13, 2024∙ Paid1823ShareFounders of Pika Labs

Hello Everyone, 

It’s going to be a major June, 2024 for text-to-video reveals and by July, the future of text-to-video will be profoundly altered. This has already begun now. 

There have been some incredible teasers in the text-to-video arena of Generative AI. Namely I’m watching: 

Kling AI (by Kuaishou)

Luma AI 

Vidu (ShengShu Technology and Tsinghua University)

Pika Labs

Zhipu AI & ByteDance (not yet released their products) 

The timeline for the release of OpenAI’s Sora 

There’s pretty strong evidence that China have already caught up with OpenAI’s Sora. 

SubscribeText-to-video capabilities is the earliest evidence that China is catching up in some ways with the U.S. in the commercial applications around Generative AI that will be released in the near future. 

As the U.S. is frantically looking to slow down China in the AI chip area, can it do the same on the application and innovation layers? How good is Luma AI and their Dream Machine? Let’s explore and show some examples.
